dim.name: nP3pblmax
dim.description: Maximum number of P3 prognostic scalars mixed by the PBL (6 per ice category, 3 categories, plus nc, nwfa and nifa with bl_ysu)

dim.name: nIceCat
dim.description: The number of P3 ice categories

nml_option.name: config_p3_nCat
nml_option.description: number of free ice categories of the P3 cloud microphysics

nml_option.name: config_p3_trplMomI
nml_option.description: triple-moment ice (P3): predicted sixth moment of each ice category (p3_qzi)

nml_option.name: config_p3_liqfrac
nml_option.description: predicted liquid fraction of each ice category (P3, p3_qli)

nml_option.name: config_p3_predictNc
nml_option.description: predicted cloud droplet number (double-moment cloud water) in P3

nml_option.name: config_p3_aerosols
nml_option.description: predicted aerosols in P3: the water- and ice-friendly aerosol numbers nwfa and nifa are allocated, advected and used by P3 (and by the RRTMG short wave aerosol optics) only if true; requires config_p3_predictNc = true

nml_option.name: config_p3_autoAccr_param
nml_option.description: warm-rain autoconversion and accretion in P3: 1 = Seifert and Beheng (2001), 2 = Khairoutdinov and Kogan (2000), 3 = Kogan (2013)

nml_option.name: config_p3_lookup_file_dir
nml_option.description: directory containing the P3 lookup tables

nml_option.name: config_p3_cu_ri
nml_option.description: mean-volume radius of the ice particles detrained by the convection scheme, used for the P3 ice number tendency, the p3_qzi tendency (triple-moment ice) and the destination ice category (config_p3_nCat > 1)

nml_option.name: config_p3_ic_bulk_ice
nml_option.description: convert the bulk ice (qi + qs + qg) of the initial conditions (data assimilation analysis, or a forecast with another microphysics scheme) to P3 ice at a cold start, as ice detrained by the convection scheme (config_p3_cu_ri). Needed only if the initial conditions contain bulk ice: qi, qs and qg are then allocated and advected (zero) for the whole run

nml_option.name: config_p3_cu_rc
nml_option.description: radius of the cloud droplets detrained by the convection scheme, used for the nc tendency (config_p3_predictNc = true)

nml_option.name: config_p3_cu_rr
nml_option.description: mean-volume radius of the rain drops detrained by the Kain-Fritsch convection scheme, used for the nr tendency

package.name: mp_p3_aers_in
package.description: P3 with predicted aerosols (config_p3_aerosols): nwfa, nifa and the aerosol surface source and optical depth active.

package.name: mp_p3_3mom_in
package.description: P3 triple-moment ice (config_p3_trplMomI): category-1 p3_qzi active.

package.name: mp_p3_3mom_cat2_in
package.description: P3 triple-moment ice with nCat >= 2: category-2 p3_qzi2 active.

package.name: mp_p3_3mom_cat3_in
package.description: P3 triple-moment ice with nCat >= 3: category-3 p3_qzi3 active.

package.name: mp_p3_lf_in
package.description: P3 predicted liquid fraction (config_p3_liqfrac): category-1 p3_qli active.

package.name: mp_p3_lf_cat2_in
package.description: P3 predicted liquid fraction with nCat >= 2: category-2 p3_qli2 active.

package.name: mp_p3_lf_cat3_in
package.description: P3 predicted liquid fraction with nCat >= 3: category-3 p3_qli3 active.

package.name: mp_p3_pbl_in
package.description: P3 with the YSU or MYNN PBL: storage for the PBL tendencies of the P3 prognostic scalars (rp3blten).

package.name: mp_p3_icice_in
package.description: P3 with config_p3_ic_bulk_ice: the bulk qi, qs and qg scalars are allocated so that the ice of the initial conditions is read, converted to P3 ice at a cold start and then kept zero.

package.name: bl_ysu_nop3_in
package.description: YSU PBL without P3 microphysics (bulk qi is not a scalar with P3).

package.name: bl_mynn_nop3_in
package.description: MYNN PBL without P3 microphysics (bulk qi, qs, ni are not scalars with P3).

package.name: cu_ntiedtke_nop3_in
package.description: Tiedtke convection without P3 microphysics (bulk qi is not a scalar with P3).
